nfte.font_note: NFTE's font is Circular. We have no file, so these use DM Sans, the closest free match.
rules: NFTE always in capitals.
No city on screen.
Transitions show footage, never black.
Navy is for text only, never a background.
One brand element at a time.
No sci-fi or AI-looking graphics.

aij.font_note: AIJ headlines use Filson Pro (no file here), so headlines use Inter Black. Body text is Inter, their own body font.
rules: Red is an accent only.
Organization name always in full: Americans for Immigrant Justice.

freedom-reads.font_note: Freedom Reads uses Metric2 and Redaction (licensed, no file here), so these use Inter.
rules: Charcoal text on off-white or cream.
Book titles exactly as printed.

kiva.font_note: Kiva uses Post Grotesk (no file here), so these use Inter.
rules: No corporate or stock look.
Logo only in a top corner, never here.

lions.font_note: Lions uses Helvetica Neue. These use Arimo, which has the same letter widths.
lions.caution: Jacqui asked for much simpler graphics, or none (8 Oct). These are kept plain. Only cut one in if the video needs it.
rules: White text on the blues, black text on the yellows.
Graphics much simpler, or none.

mha.font_note: MHA's own fonts: Gloock for headings, Schibsted Grotesk for body.
rules: Never the orange from their website.
No logo (no file yet).

s4s.font_note: Soles4Souls titles use Buenos Aires (no file here), so titles use Roboto Black. Body is Roboto, their own body font.
rules: Black text on teal. Never white on teal.
Big, readable text.

sfcg.font_note: SFCG uses a heavy grotesque (Neue Haas Grotesk class, no file here), so these use Inter Black.
sfcg.caution: Kalindi called animation in the middle of a video “inauthentic”. These are kept simple. Use one only where a line needs it.
rules: Blue-forward, never only black and white.
Yellow is for donate buttons only.

wny-womens-foundation.font_note: WNYWF has not settled its font (Rubato or Roboto), so these use Roboto.
rules: #872175 is the video color, white text on it.

curegrin.font_note: Colors from curegrin.org (their purple). No brand font on file, so these use Inter.
rules: Never alter the CureGRIN logo lockup (no logos here).
Titles in Title Case, names spelled from Quinn's list.

dream-center-dallas.font_note: Dream Center has not sent brand colors or a font yet. The green is from dreamcenterdallas.com. Font is Montserrat as a stand-in.
dream-center-dallas.caution: Brand colors are not confirmed by Kacie yet. Fine for a first cut. Swap colors if Nick gets the brand files.
rules: First names only for neighbors.
Subtitles on every line.

family-reach.font_note: Colors from familyreach.org. Their font is ITC Avant Garde (no file here), so these use Poppins.
family-reach.caution: Family Reach: never change a word of their VO or on-screen text. Every line here is word for word from the footage.
rules: New brand only.
Hook on frame 1, no card at 0:00.

freedom-to-choose.font_note: Colors and fonts from freedomtochooseproject.org: purple, orange key words, Roboto Condensed and Open Sans.
rules: Purple box, white text, key words orange.
Logo only at the end.

gateway-gaston.font_note: Colors and fonts from gatewaygaston.org (green, Montserrat). No brand guide on file.
gateway-gaston.caution: No brand guide on file. Colors are from their website.
rules: One ask per video: Comment “I'm in”.
Logo only at the end.

niwrc.font_note: Colors and fonts from niwrc.org (Oswald, Source Sans). Women Are Sacred 2027 uses Luminos Marker; no license confirmed, so not used.
rules: Captions never over graphic slides.
No duotone over photos.
Names and titles exactly as NIWRC gives them.

momcozy.font_note: Momcozy's font is Inter, so these use Inter.
rules: Momcozy is one word, capital M. Wordmark MOMCOZY in caps on the end card only.
No colour that is not on the Momcozy sheet.
Captions white with a soft shadow, easy to read.
No prices or discount numbers in these graphics.

cass.font_note: Work Sans, the CASS site body font. The site uses Aboreto for display headings; it is a thin all-caps face, so graphics use Work Sans ExtraBold for headlines.
rules: Logo only on the end card, never at 0:00.
CASS always in capitals.
Captions: white on the navy #2C2B77 box.

learn-fresh.font_note: Learn Fresh's font is RangleRiforma Bold. We have no web file here, so previews use Inter. Neutral colours until the style guide colours are loaded.
rules: NBA Math Hoops, never MBA.
No school names on screen.
Students: first name + last initial + grade.

ycdif.font_note: Colours and fonts from the ycdif.com site CSS (client file, mined 7 Jul 2026): headings Plus Jakarta Sans, body Fustat, both Google Fonts. No brand guide or font files on file. Headings set to 700 for legibility on video (the site uses 500).
rules: Black text on gold. Never white on gold (too little contrast).
Logo on the end card only, and none on social versions.
Kris with a K. Rob Schneider is the spokesperson: never founder.

worldreader.font_note: Montserrat is the font of worldreader.org (all site typography), on Google Fonts. Colors from the Worldreader client file: logo blue #285BD5, navy #104065, magenta #BC33A9 (worldreader.org), caption azure #0089FD (approved South Africa cut).
rules: Worldreader is one word; BookSmart has a capital S.
Never frame families as charity cases.
Challenge copy: always free, never “free for September”.

navy-seal-foundation.font_note: Oswald and Open Sans, the fonts on navysealfoundation.org (client file). Colours from the site theme and NSF-Logo.svg (client file, mined 7 Jul 2026).
rules: Always “the Navy SEAL Foundation”. SEAL in capitals, singular.
No logo before the end card. No one in uniform.
Gold for accents only, never body text on white.

segway.font_note: Segway's brand font is not on file (asked from Mavis Chen) and the site font MiSans is not on Google Fonts, so these use Inter, a clean neutral sans. Colours from the Segway Germany site stylesheet (de-de.segway.com), read 3 Nov 2026.
rules: No speed numbers anywhere.
German on screen, checked word by word.
Segway, Ninebot, Segway-Ninebot spelled exactly.
